facts.anchor: Kiamling regretted her heavy meal when someone banged on the door before dawn. She wiped the sleep from her eyes, staring up into the troubled face of Foreman Leung. “I’ve been waiting for hours!” he said.
facts.fact: 天亮前有人猛敲门，金玲被吵醒；来人是工头梁（Foreman Leung），他开口就说“我等了好几个钟头！”她后悔前一晚吃得太饱。

facts.anchor: “I haven’t had a night’s sleep since the fire! Behind schedule on building the police station and now everyone is desperate for home repairs. I was relying on you. You know the crew won’t build the station without them.”
facts.fact: 梁工头说大火后没睡过整夜：警局工程已落后，如今人人急着修屋；他一直指望金玲，因为工人没有她（当天该装的）门神就不肯建警局。

facts.anchor: Door gods were being pampered with joss sticks, and pyramids of fruit graced the shrines in every house and shop. Without the blessings for breaking ground, the workers would not lift a finger.
facts.fact: 门神被上香供奉，家家店铺的神龛前堆起水果塔；没有破土祝福，工人一根手指都不肯动。

facts.anchor: “It’s yiugwai business.” The cloud of Kiamling’s anger snapped out at her sister, an innocent bystander in all of this.
facts.fact: 金玲把火气撒向妹妹，只说“这是阴间活儿”——静玲在这场事里只是无辜旁观者。

facts.anchor: Jingling did not respond to the tongue-lashing as she could have. Serene as the lotus flowers on a lake. “I’ve lived with yiugwai hunters for all of my eighteen years. I could be of assistance.”
facts.fact: 静玲没有回嘴，平静如湖上莲花，说自己在阴间猎人身边活了整整十八年，可以帮上忙。

facts.anchor: “Of a monster prowling the streets at night. Attacking people. They’ve probably just found better work elsewhere. Half of those coming through Hong Kong leave. And now they say there will be another war.”
facts.fact: 梁工头承认人手不够，说传言有怪物夜里上街伤人；他猜那些人只是另找了活计——过香港的人有一半会离开，而且据说又要打仗。

facts.anchor: He laughed, a rare sound from the overworked carpenter. “Now, now, you shouldn’t call the English priest that!”
facts.fact: 金玲提起那场火里的“兽”，这位过劳的木匠难得大笑，回她“喂喂，你可不该这样叫那位英国神父！”——他把“兽”当成在说英国神父。

facts.anchor: He had left, Kiamling remembered, gone to help those getting water from the harbourfront. It was unsurprising that he assumed the stories of a shadow beast were just that. Children’s tales.
facts.fact: 金玲想起大火时梁已经离开、去海边帮人取水，所以他自然把暗影兽的传闻只当成小孩故事。

facts.anchor: It had only been a few months since Kiamling and Por Por had cleared the burial site for the new police station. Already the outer brick walls had been constructed.
facts.fact: 金玲与婆婆（Por Por）几个月前才为新警局清理过坟地，如今外墙砖已砌好，工人等她装门神才复工。

facts.anchor: Kiamling pasted the vibrant papers of the deities’ images to the double front doors of the station, lighting joss sticks and saying the ritual words.
facts.fact: 金玲把神像彩纸贴到警局双扇正门上，点香并念仪式词；工人礼貌点头却像河水绕石般绕开她，还自带水果鲜花供在门边。

facts.anchor: “Misfortune sits on that woman’s shoulders,” one man said quietly to his colleague in Hakka. He glanced over his shoulder, unaware that she was close enough to hear them.
facts.fact: 工人用客家话低声说“霉运压在那女人肩上”，还回头张望，不知道金玲近得能听见——这些话她全听见了。

facts.anchor: “Did you hear they fled Canton with only the clothes on their backs?” “I heard there’s a price on their heads…” The man made a neck-cutting motion with his finger as he spoke.
facts.fact: 工人说她俩“只带着身上衣服逃出广州”，又说“听说有人出价买她们的人头”，边说边以手作割颈状。

facts.anchor: Por Por had always told them to stay away from Canton, but she had not said anything about why. Foolish of Kiamling never to ask, simply accepting the half-answer for what it was.
facts.fact: 金玲震惊：婆婆一向叫她们远离广州，却从没说过原因；她懊悔自己从不追问、只接受半截答案，并自问祖母还瞒着什么秘密。

facts.anchor: Well, she had run out of excuses. And there was only one place that might have some answers.
facts.fact: 章末她认定自己再无借口，而且只有一个地方可能藏着答案。
